paragraphs: R' Chanina, companion of the Sages. See the entry R' Chananyah, companion of the Sages.[^1]

notes.text: חברון דרבנן means companion of the Sages in this construction, not the place Hebron. The second line completes the target qualifier. Chanina and Chananyah remain distinct supplied forms, and both abbreviated titles remain R'.
